en.topic_title: Hong Kong police activate facial recognition across AI-enabled CCTV network, as police chief says tools ‘won’t be abused’
en.topic_summary:
The Hong Kong Police Force has announced that it will activate facial recognition tools across its surveillance camera system on Monday. The measure is part of a HK$4 billion plan to expand the AI-enabled CCTV network.



SmartView camera feeds. File Photo: HKPF.



Police Commissioner Joe Chow told TVB on Sunday that the technology would be rolled out across its SmartView network.



“All of our investigation tools have the requirement of check and balance, so that they won’t be abused&#8
